bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
c=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
printf 'PROJECT_ROOT=%s\n' "$PWD"
printf 'BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git branch --show-current)"
printf 'HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'DIRTY_COUNT=%s\n' "$(git status --porcelain | wc -l)"
if ! docker container inspect "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo CONTAINER_MISSING; exit 41; fi
docker inspect "$c" --format 'COMPOSE_PROJECT={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}} COMPOSE_WORKDIR={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}} COMPOSE_CONFIG={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}} IMAGE_ID={{.Image}}'
docker exec "$c" sh -c 'if grep -Fq "stickerLandingPanel" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerSales.mjs; then echo STICKER_SALE_RETURN_FIX=ACTIVE; else echo STICKER_SALE_RETURN_FIX=MISSING; fi; if grep -Fq "uniqueAcknowledgedAppend" /opt/videobot/src/stickers/packRegistration.mjs; then echo STICKER_APPEND_FIX=ACTIVE; else echo STICKER_APPEND_FIX=MISSING; fi'
printf 'RUNTIME_INSPECTION=COMPLETE\n'
